description: This file contains utility functions for web UI scripting, including session management wrappers, string manipulation, data grouping, time conversions, network address resolutions, and device type determination functions.

methods.name: php_getstr
methods.description: Wraps access to session mode and conditionally returns strings.

methods.name: php_getinstanceids
methods.description: Wraps access to instance IDs with session mode checks.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Maps root object parameters to key-value pairs from external GET/DM function.

methods.name: encrypt_map
methods.description: Maps encryption modes and methods to descriptive strings.

methods.name: getLeafName
methods.description: Extracts the leaf name from a parameter string based on the root.

methods.name: getObjIdInPath
methods.description: Extracts object ID ({i}) from a parameter path based on root.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Retrieves and processes multiple parameter values for given roots and mappings.

methods.name: init_psmMode
methods.description: Generates webpage content indicating PSM mode status.

methods.name: php_str_and
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND on two hexadecimal strings.

methods.name: array_trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from array elements, removing empty entries.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Reads default configuration values from an XML file.

methods.name: div_sub
methods.description: Performs division by subtraction.

methods.name: hm_to_sec
methods.description: Converts hours and minutes to seconds.

methods.name: sec_to_hm
methods.description: Converts seconds to hours and minutes format.

methods.name: shift_blockedDays
methods.description: Shifts blocked days array forwards or backwards by one day.

methods.name: group_2D_array
methods.description: Groups a dataset into nested arrays based on specified fields.

methods.name: local_to_UTC_Time
methods.description: Converts local time to UTC, adjusting for day changes based on time offset.

methods.name: UTC_to_local_Time
methods.description: Converts UTC time to local time, adjusting for day changes.

methods.name: UTC_to_local_date
methods.description: Converts UTC date/time string to local date/time.

methods.name: UTC_to_local_date_logs
methods.description: Converts UTC date/time string to local logs format.

methods.name: time_in_min
methods.description: Converts a time string to total minutes.

methods.name: cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting schedules by start time.

methods.name: merge_days
methods.description: Merges overlapping or consecutive time blocks.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_get
methods.description: Processes scheduled data to convert times between UTC and local.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_set
methods.description: Sets UTC schedule times from local times with day change considerations.

methods.name: time_date_conflict
methods.description: Checks for conflicts between two time schedules.

methods.name: resolve_IPV6_global_address
methods.description: Resolves the global IPv6 address from inputs, defaulting as needed.

methods.name: get_wan_type
methods.description: Determines the WAN connection type based on device model and interfaces.
